Messages.Body:
Hi, a question about thanks for the donation:

say, i'm contesting a hunting ground, i play TftD,
and the methuselah contesting with me yelds.
Later in the game, my hunting ground (the one chosen with my TftD) become
contested again:
does the effect of my TftD (assuming it is still in play) applies again?

Thanks in advance

Aemilianus, vekn prince of Rome
